linkedin.paused_reason: owner_decision_2026-08-29: "drop linkedin for now its not important", and "i might bring linkedin back at anytime". LinkedIn is paused on purpose and is expected to come back. It is NOT off because LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN / LINKEDIN_AUTHOR_URN are missing from repository secrets -- that absence follows from this decision rather than causing it. This record exists so "paused by choice", "on but uncredentialled" and "on and posting" are three visibly different states instead of one blank secret.

named_stops.linkedin: linkedin_paused_by_switch: owner_decision_2026-08-29: "drop linkedin for now its not important", and "i might bring linkedin back at anytime". LinkedIn is paused on purpose and is expected to come back. It is NOT off because LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN / LINKEDIN_AUTHOR_URN are missing from repository secrets -- that absence follows from this decision rather than causing it. This record exists so "paused by choice", "on but uncredentialled" and "on and posting" are three visibly different states instead of one blank secret.
